findings.summary: The plan does not say which athena.toml cutover_base reads cutover_job from.
findings.evidence: history.rs:44-50 reads cutover_job from the tip's own athena.toml (config_at(git, Some(&resolved))), and gh.rs:1613 cutover_job_for reads it from a given commit. The plan says cutover_base 'returns early when cutover_job is unset' but does not say which athena.toml it reads. Decision 2 also turns down 'strip whenever cutover_job is configured' because the checkout's own athena.toml names it. Fix: Say that cutover_base reads cutover_job from the athena.toml at the commit (or parent) it is given, using config_at as check_history does, and not from the checkout. Then the writers, the gate and check_history use one switch.

findings.summary: The test's squash commit must be created inside FakeHost.merge, not after land_pr returns.
findings.evidence: gh.rs:1827 calls job.host.merge(link.pr_number, &link.head, job.squash) before the landing record is written. cutover_world (gh.rs:4289-4301) builds the squash commit and pushes it to trunk before landing. In the new test the squash text is only known when merge is called. Fix: State that FakeHost.merge itself runs commit_tree with the text it receives and pushes the result to the remote trunk, so the landing record's host_commit is that squash commit.

findings.summary: The plan's list of LandPr struct literals leaves out one call site outside gh.rs.
findings.evidence: Besides the gh.rs literals (lines 2735, 3003, 3351, 3424, 3866), crates/athena-cli/tests/external_calls.rs:476 also sets `squash: &squash`. Unsized coercion of &CommitText to &dyn SquashText in a struct field should compile, but the plan counts only about 7 gh.rs literals. Fix: Add external_calls.rs to the list of call sites to check when compiling. Note that it compiles through the CommitText impl and needs no edit.

findings.summary: Three listed deliverables may not change at all.
findings.evidence: lifecycle.rs, main.rs and land.rs are listed as deliverables (modify), but the plan says it touches them only if a compile need appears. Fix: In the summary, tell the verifier that these three files may go unchanged, and why (criterion 2 allows leaving out the CLI check).

summary: The plan matches the accepted reading and fixes the problems from the earlier rounds. I checked these points against the snapshot. The free land_pr now picks the squash text itself through a SquashText trait, so the end-to-end test runs the same code as production; the merge call is at gh.rs:1827 and the field to change is LandPr.squash at gh.rs:1271. Writers switch on the same Shown state check_history uses (attribution.rs:69-144, history.rs:47-63). The landing record's second parent is correctly taken from the records commit (gh.rs:1326). Classification works from records, not trailers (land.rs:162-171), so the stripped intervention and records-only commits can still be classified. commit_with_staged exists on Athena (manage.rs:407), and Committer::build_commit_in runs the gate (commits.rs:172), so the three-commit test exercises the real gate. Each demonstration would fail without its behavior. The only gaps are small: which athena.toml cutover_base reads, when FakeHost creates the squash commit, and one more LandPr literal in external_calls.rs. No governance file changes.
